title: Mapping interactions between disordered regions reveals promiscuity in biomolecular condensate formation
authors: Gilat A; Dubrueil B; Levy ED
one_liner_zh: 该文通过合成micDROP系统系统性地绘制无序区域间互作图谱，揭示IDR在相分离凝聚体形成中的混杂性，并发现TDP43的α-螺旋段介导特异性自识别，直接聚焦IDR-IDR互作机制与相分离，兼具实验与序列分析，对本课题的互作机制建模有重要启发。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Intrinsically-disordered regions (IDRs) promote intracellular phase separation and the formation of biomolecular condensates through interactions encoded in their primary sequence. While these condensates form spatially distinct assemblies in cells, it is unclear whether such specificity can be conferred by IDRs alone. Indeed, IDRs exhibit high conformational flexibility whereas specificity in protein recognition is generally associated with well-defined 3D structures. To characterize IDR-IDR interactions and assess their ability to mediate self-specific partitioning, we developed a synthetic system of Multivalent IDRs forming Constitutive DROPlets ( micDROP ). We investigated ten natural IDRs that underwent phase separation in micDROP . These IDRs exhibited a wide range of saturation concentrations in vivo , which correlated well with their total sequence stickiness. We then probed IDR-IDR specificity by co-expressing pairs of IDRs fused to homologous scaffolds that did not co-assemble. We observed a high degree of promiscuity, particularly among IDRs from the proteins Ddx4, DYRK3, ERα, FUS, hnRNPA1, HspB8, RBM14 and TAF15, whereas TDP43 and UBQ2 formed spatially distinct condensates regardless of their partner. Further investigation revealed the short and conserved α-helical segment of TDP43’s IDR was governing its specific self-recognition. Our findings imply that IDRs can tune their phase separation propensity through sequence composition, while their formation of discrete condensates likely requires additional cellular or structural determinants.

abstract_zh:
摘要

内在无序区域（IDRs）通过其一级序列中编码的相互作用促进细胞内相分离及生物分子凝聚体的形成。尽管这些凝聚体在细胞中形成空间上不同的组装体，但尚不清楚这种特异性是否仅由IDRs单独赋予。确实，IDRs表现出高度的构象灵活性，而蛋白质识别中的特异性通常与明确的三维结构相关。为了表征IDR-IDR相互作用并评估其介导自我特异性分配的能力，我们开发了一个由多价IDRs组成构成性液滴（micDROP）的合成系统。我们研究了十个在micDROP中经历相分离的天然IDRs。这些IDRs在体内表现出广泛的饱和浓度范围，与其总序列粘性良好相关。随后，我们通过共表达融合到不共组装的同源支架上的IDR对来探测IDR-IDR特异性。我们观察到高度的混杂性，尤其是在来自蛋白质Ddx4、DYRK3、ERα、FUS、hnRNPA1、HspB8、RBM14和TAF15的IDRs中，而TDP43和UBQ2则无论其伴侣如何都形成空间上不同的凝聚体。进一步研究表明，TDP43的IDR中短且保守的α-螺旋片段控制着其特异性自我识别。我们的发现暗示IDRs可以通过序列组成调节其相分离倾向，而它们形成离散凝聚体可能还需要额外的细胞或结构决定因素。
